'''K'lor'slugs''' were dangerous vermiforms native to the swamps of [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|Noe'ha'on]]. They were also found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR Slug">{{TORweb|url=media/concepts/klorslug|text=Concept Art &ndash; K'lor'slug|nolive=1}}</ref> and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Biology and Appearance==
[[File:KirithinKlorslug-AlienAnthology.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A k'lor'slug faces off against a [[Kirithin]]]]
K'lor'slugs were large worm-like creatures that possessed a serpentine body propelled by many dangerously-edged legs. The mouth was a gaping circular maw filled with concentric rings of teeth.

==Behavior==
K'lor'slugs were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] hunters on their [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|homeworld]], possessing keen olfactory and visual senses in addition to a deadly venom. For reproduction, the creatures could lay more than 300 eggs in a single birthing period. When hatched, the young k'lor'slug was immediately ravenous for food.
In addition to their aggressiveness, these creatures were considered pests aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were known to invade the darkest spots on unsanitary space vehicles and breed. When dealing with more than 300 eggs hatching, an infestation aboard a space vehicle would become harder to control&mdash;and more potentially fatal&mdash;the longer it was tolerated.

==History==
[[File:KlorslugsKitchen-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|250px|K'lor'slugs prepared for eating in a kitchen]]
K'lor'slugs were known to the galaxy as early as the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Because of their notoriety as an aggressive and deadly species, especially among the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who encountered them aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]], they were used as a [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] playing piece in the popular strategy game, [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]].

==Behind the scenes==
The k'lor'slugs in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' feature a few significant differences with the dejarik piece seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. In the movie, the face of the k'lor'slug was depicted as rather snake-like, while in the game it's a gaping maw without distinguishable eyes or nostrils.
